title: Pessoa Engenheira de Inteligência Artificial - Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

A posição de AI Software Architect exige uma combinação de visão estratégica e expertise técnica em inteligência artificial, habilidades interpessoais e interesse em atuar próximo ao universo comercial. O foco está na construção de propostas assertivas durante a prospecção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, garantindo soluções alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e escaláveis para o futuro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Colaborar com o Arquiteto de Soluções AI para transformar demandas de negócios em modelos e pipelines de ML/IA escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Implementar modelos de IA, validando performance e garantindo integração nas arquiteturas existentes.
  • Desenvolver pipelines robustos de dados: coleta, processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos.
  • Integrar soluções de IA em ambientes de produção, alinhando-se às melhores práticas de MLOps (monitoramento, automação e escalabilidade, conhecimento sobre MlFlow ou plataformas como AzureML ou Google VertexAI).
  • Trabalhar próximo ao time comercial e de produto para prototipar e validar propostas, com entregas iterativas e soluções centradas no cliente.
  • Participar ativamente na avaliação de riscos técnicos (performance, escalabilidade, segurança) e colaborar na aplicação de soluções preventivas.
  • Garantir o uso eficiente de ferramentas cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) no desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções.
  • Colaborar na criação de documentação técnica e melhores práticas em alinhamento com o arquiteto e outros stakeholders.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps e CI/CD (MLflow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Sólida experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e práticas de otimização de consultas.
  • Experiência com serviços cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

title: Keeta-Partner Operation Strategy Manager 合作商质量控制策略运营
description:
Responsibilities:


1. Responsible for formulating the partner quality control strategy to ensure that the operational quality of partners meets the standards.

2. Take charge of establishing and optimizing the partner quality evaluation system, designing a hierarchical exit mechanism, and collaborating with frontline teams to promptly replace inferior partners.

3. Coordinate various departments such as frontline teams, assessment and pricing teams, and partner management teams to ensure that the exit process is reasonable and risks are controllable.


Requirements:


1. A bachelor's degree or above, with no restrictions on majors.

2. Candidates with more than 3 years of experience in Platform Governence, business analysis, 3PL management, etc. will be given priority.

3. Strong data analysis and communication - coordination skills are required. Candidates with experience in building incentive systems and scoring systems, as well as those with SQL skills, will be preferred.

4. Relevant work experience in formulating fulfillment and delivery strategies, rider management, etc. is required. Familiarity with fulfillment and delivery management under the crowdsourcing and franchise models is also required.

5. Proficiency in English, which should be used as the working language.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and/or sales opportunities with key customers.
The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.
In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.
Your Impact
  • Escalation Leadership
    • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
    • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
    • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
    • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
    • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
    • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
    • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
    • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
    • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
    • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
    • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
    • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
    • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
    • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
    • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
    • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process/system/product
    • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
    • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
    • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
    • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Fully fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish both written and verbal
  • Customer Experience
    • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and/or service delivery roles
    • Past experience as Escalations Engineer/Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
    • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program/Project management
    • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
    • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
    • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA/SLO/Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
    • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
    • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
    • Experience with Networking/Security Products
    • Knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies, encompassing general routing/switching/security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues
Additional Information
The Team
The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.
Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making
As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.
Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

    • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators

  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers

    • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
    • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Pleno (Java com exp. em Cloud)
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.

♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent?

Conhecimento técnico:

  • Levantamento e Análise de Requisitos;
  • Modelagem de Dados; Conhecimento em Modelagem UML e/ou Análise Estruturada;
  • Conhecer Linguagem de Programação Java; Conhecer Banco de Dados (Ex.: SQL, DB2, Oracle, SyBase);
  • Desenvolvimento micro serviços Java, usando Liberty+JAX-RS ou Springboot;
  • Conhecer design patterns de integração, composição e comunicação de micro serviços (eventos, filas);
  • Experiência em Log/trace (ELK/Dynatrace) Conhecimento de APIs/Swagger, Banco de dados oracle e Mongo DB;
  • Bons conhecimentos de CSS, HTML, APIs;
  • Framework JSF;
  • JavaScript/JQuery.

Responsabilidades

  • Colaborar com a equipe para criar soluções eficientes, escaláveis e alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio;
  • Implementar e aplicar arquitetura hexagonal para garantir a flexibilidade e escalabilidade das soluções;
  • Adotar as melhores práticas de Clean Code, com foco na qualidade e legibilidade do código;
  • Ser capaz de revisar e melhorar o próprio código, antecipando e resolvendo problemas antes que se tornem críticos;
  • Escrever testes unitários com Mockito e garantir boa cobertura de testes.

Formato de Trabalho

Remoto

E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

description:
Key Account Manager – iGaming

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil OR Remote

Full-Time | Competitive Salary (DOE)


Are you ready to play a key role in one of the world’s leading iGaming casino content providers? A global powerhouse with €2bn+ in revenue and over 20,000 employees worldwide is now looking for a strong Key Account Manager to join their dynamic team in Sao Paulo .


This is a fantastic opportunity to work at the heart of a publicly-listed, innovative business that is shaping the future of online gaming content. You'll manage strategic partnerships, foster long-term client relationships, and help deliver engaging gaming experiences across global markets.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with key clients, acting as the primary point of contact.
  • Represent the full portfolio of products and communicate upcoming game releases and opportunities.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to plan and execute successful promotional campaigns.
  • Analyse campaign performance and proactively address any issues.
  • Identify evolving client needs and deliver tailored solutions aligned with business objectives.
  • Resolve customer issues efficiently and implement improvements based on root-cause analysis.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure seamless service delivery and maximum client satisfaction.


What We're Looking For:

  • 3–5 years’ experience in account management in the online B2B iGaming sector.
  • Proven success in building and growing client relationships in a commercial setting.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
  • Fluent in English; Portuguese proficiency is a strong asset.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint); Power BI experience is a plus.
  • Professional demeanour with the flexibility to travel and work outside standard hours when needed.


If you have the experience outlined above, and want to join the global market leader in casino content, please get in touch today!

title: SAP Data Assurance Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Data Assurance Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)



Lead the end-to-end SAP data conversion and loading lifecycle, including technical data preparation, conversion, execution of data loads, defect management, and reporting.

Collaborate with project managers, functional leads, developers, and business stakeholders to define test strategies and ensure alignment with project goals.

Coordinate and manage data conversion and data testing cycles.

Ensure traceability between data conversion requirements, test cases, and defects.

Oversee data preparation in coordination with SAP platform, functional and other teams.

Provide leadership and mentorship to other data team members and ensure adherence to data conversion best practices and standards.

Track and report data preparation and conversion progress, risks, and issues to project leadership.


Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in SAP data conversion, with at least 3 years in a data conversion or related data management role.

Strong understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, etc.) and their integration points.

Experience with SAP S/4HANA data conversion is preferred.

Proficiency in data conversion tools such as ADM by Syniti.

Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.


Preferred Skills

Experience with data conversion tools and frameworks.

Familiarity with Agile and hybrid project methodologies.

Knowledge of data conversion tools such as ADM by Syniti.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei profissional da área de desenvovlimento venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a/e) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


- Experiência mínima de 2 anos em desenvolvimento frontend, com foco em React Native para aplicativos mobile.

* Forte conhecimento em TypeScript e JavaScript.

* Experiência prática com bibliotecas de gerenciamento de estado em apps móveis, especialmente Redux.

* Conhecimento em Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config).

* Vivência com CI/CD para distribuição e deploy de aplicativos móveis.

* Domínio em controle de versão utilizando Git e aplicação de boas práticas em versionamento.

* Experiência em testes automatizados com Jest.


Desejável: * Familiaridade com ferramentas de documentação de API, como Swagger.

* Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e boas práticas de gestão de projetos. Tecnologias e Ferramentas que você irá utilizar:

* Backend: NestJS e Node.js

* Frontend Mobile: React Native

* Cloud: AWS (SQS, S3)

* Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config)

* Linguagens: TypeScript e JavaScript

* Versionamento: Git


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Instrutor MQ Series
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Instrutor MQ Series


Estamos buscando um **Instrutor especializado em IBM MQ** para ministrar curso voltado para desenvolvedores, com foco em integração de sistemas mainframe e aplicações modernas. O profissional será responsável por capacitar equipes de desenvolvimento em tecnologias de mensageria corporativa, COBOL e boas práticas de integração.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS

Ensino e Treinamento

  • Ministrar cursos remotos sobre IBM MQ para desenvolvedores
  • Desenvolver e atualizar material didático (apresentações, exercícios práticos, documentação)
  • Criar cenários de simulação e laboratórios práticos
  • Avaliar o progresso dos alunos e fornecer feedback construtivo
  • Adaptar o conteúdo conforme o nível técnico da turma

Desenvolvimento de Conteúdo

  • Elaborar guias de melhores práticas para IBM MQ
  • Criar exemplos práticos de integração COBOL + IBM MQ
  • Desenvolver casos de uso reais para exercícios
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada
  • Produzir material de apoio (manuais, quick references, troubleshooting guides)

Suporte Técnico

  • Auxiliar desenvolvedores na resolução de problemas técnicos
  • Fornecer consultoria em arquitetura de soluções com IBM MQ
  • Apoiar na implementação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Realizar code reviews e orientações técnicas

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

Experiência Técnica

  • Mínimo 5 anos** de experiência com IBM MQ (WebSphere MQ)
  • Experiência sólida** em desenvolvimento COBOL
  • Conhecimento em **ambientes mainframe** (z/OS, CICS, DB2)
  • Experiência com **integração de sistemas** e arquiteturas SOA/ESB
  • Conhecimento em **JCL, copybooks** e estruturas de dados mainframe

Experiência em Ensino

  • Mínimo 2 anos** ministrando treinamentos técnicos
  • Experiência com **desenvolvimento de material didático**
  • Habilidade para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara

Competências Técnicas Específicas

  • Configuração e administração de Queue Managers**
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações que utilizam MQGET, MQPUT, MQOPEN, MQCLOSE**
  • Conhecimento em MQ Channels, Queues, Topics**
  • Experiência com MQ Explorer** e ferramentas de monitoramento
  • Troubleshooting de problemas de conectividade e performance
  • Conhecimento em MQ Security** (SSL/TLS, autenticação, autorização)

Soft Skills

  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Paciência e didática para ensinar
  • Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes perfis de alunos
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas
  • Trabalho em equipe e colaboração

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

Certificações

  • IBM Certified Solution Developer - WebSphere MQ



Formação Acadêmica


  • Graduação completa.

PJ

title: Tech Lead | Data Engineering
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro

A Getnet é uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Fundada no Brasil e presente na América Latina e na Península Ibérica, apoiamos mais de 1,3 milhão de comerciantes com serviços completos — da maquininha ao e-commerce.

Fazemos parte da PagoNxt , a fintech global do Grupo Santander, e atuamos como um hub de adquirência com forte presença em Espanha, Portugal, Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai .

Nossa missão é clara: simplificar os pagamentos com inovação, segurança e escala , ajudando negócios de todos os tamanhos a crescer com agilidade.

Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio.

Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global.

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?


Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Tech Lead - Data Engineering para se juntar ao nosso time em Data Plataform.


O que você vai fazer

Como Tech Lead de Data Engineering, você será a referência técnica em nossa infraestrutura de Data Platform, liderando iniciativas relacionadas à gestão de dados de interação com nossos clientes, incluindo a elaboração de demonstrativos de vendas e extratos. Terá papel fundamental na Transformação Tecnológica, apoiando a transição de sistemas legados (Oracle, PL SQL, OpenShift) para tecnologias modernas (Spark/Scala, SQL, Databricks, Atlas, Kubernetes), garantindo a continuidade dos negócios e a minimização de riscos.


  • Você será referência Técnica: Atuando como especialista técnico, orientando o time de engenharia em boas práticas, arquitetura e decisões estratégicas de tecnologia.
  • Colaboração com Stakeholders: Trabalhar próximo a times de produto, tecnologia e negócio para entender necessidades e traduzir em soluções eficazes.
  • Evolução Tecnológica: Apoiar a modernização de sistemas e migração para ambientes em nuvem, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e desempenho.
  • Integração de Sistemas: Projetar e apoiar integrações de novos sistemas com a infraestrutura existente, assegurando eficiência operacional.
  • Cultura de Inovação: Promover boas práticas de engenharia, cultura de colaboração e aprendizado contínuo no time.
  • Conciliação de Informações: Apoiar a construção de soluções para conciliações de pequenos, médios e grandes comércios, além de fluxos regulatórios (bandeiras, BACEN, etc.).


✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Experiência em Arquitetura de Software: Sólido conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura, engenharia de software e data engineering.
  • Gestão de Riscos Técnicos: Capacidade de identificar riscos em soluções e propor alternativas.
  • Vivência técnica com: ORACLE, PL SQL, SQL, JAVA, DATABRICKS, SPARK/SCALA;
  • Kubernetes e Cloud (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud);
  • APIs e Integrações: atuação em Integração de Sistemas: Capacidade de projetar e validar soluções interoperáveis em ambientes complexos.


✅ O que pode contar pontos a mais

  • Experiência em empresas de adquirência ou tecnologia.
  • Familiaridade com fluxo de extrato financeiro.
  • Atuação anterior como Tech Lead ou Especialista Técnico em projetos de modernização de plataformas de dados.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the job


At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.



About the Opportunity


We are seeking a Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.

You’ll join a collaborative, empowered, and agile team responsible for enterprise data distribution applications and backend APIs that serve external customers worldwide, including international markets such as Canada and Japan . This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical DevOps operations, design scalable solutions, and continuously evolve our platform’s reliability, performance, and security.


Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Lead and own DevOps initiatives , including CI/CD pipeline management, cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform , ensuring secure, reproducible, and automated deployments.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing systems .
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness and compliance with security best practices .
  • Manage and optimize AWS services (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, IAM, VPC, ECR, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker images in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation .
  • Collaborate across engineering teams (Platform, Security, UX) to ensure seamless integration and delivery.


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of professional experience in functional programming , with Node.js / JavaScript (not TypeScript).
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and cloud-native environments .
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker .
  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Familiarity with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.
  • Pragmatic mindset with a strong sense of ownership and craftsmanship .


Nice to Have Skills


  • Experience with automated database migrations and versioning.
  • Background in API integration and distribution systems .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Exposure to multi-region cloud deployments .
  • Previous experience supporting regulated industries or compliance-driven environments.
  • Passion for mentoring team members and driving engineering best practices.



Avenue Code ensures the privacy of all candidates in compliance with regulations such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. The data will be used solely for recruitment processes and may be shared, in a limited manner, with clients and CompassUOL Group companies when necessary to provide services.

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Contract

Location: Remote - Brazil

Industry: IT & Services, Data & Analytics.


Business Systems Analyst | About You

As a Business Systems Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the success of a Pay-Per-Use program by identifying, triaging, and resolving data and process discrepancies tied to financial operations. You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. You’re comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don’t interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes. You are detail-oriented, naturally curious, and confident working independently to drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.


Business Systems Analyst | Day-to-Day

  • Triage and resolve data issues within the Pay-Per-Use program by identifying root causes and directing them to the appropriate teams.
  • Maintain and manage the team’s Jira board, including issue tracking, documentation, and validation of outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot and update Tableau reports (10–15 dashboards), ensuring accuracy and relevance of the displayed data.
  • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.
  • Contribute to chatbot proof-of-concept development by providing data insights and supporting testing activities.


Business Systems Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Proficient in writing SQL queries for data investigation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience modifying and troubleshooting Tableau dashboards and working with backend data sources.
  • Skilled in managing issues in Jira and working across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with navigating Salesforce and SAP for data verification (no development or admin experience required).

title: TECH LEAD - TIME DESENVOLVIMENTO, REMOTO
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento ágil, garantindo a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade, escaláveis e alinhadas às metas de negócio.

- Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de sistemas, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia de software, segurança da informação, automação e observabilidade.

- Atuar como facilitador entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, traduzindo necessidades estratégicas em soluções tecnológicas eficientes.

- Conduzir o planejamento e acompanhamento de projetos, assegurando prazos, custos, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e qualidade das entregas.

- Implementar padrões de governança técnica, versionamento, testes automatizados, CI/CD e monitoramento contínuo de performance.

- Apoiar o crescimento técnico do time por meio de mentorias, feedbacks estruturados e planos de desenvolvimento individual.

- Fomentar uma cultura de colaboração, aprendizado contínuo, inovação e melhoria constante nos processos de desenvolvimento.

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
O Grupo SCTODODIA é um dos principais grupos de comunicação de Santa Catarina, conectando o público às notícias e ao entretenimento através de nossas plataformas consolidadas: rádio, portal de notícias e redes sociais. Estamos em expansão e buscando um novo talento para integrar nossa força de vendas.


Missão do cargo:


Buscamos um(a) profissional apaixonado(a) por vendas e comunicação para atuar como Consultor(a) Comercial. O objetivo é expandir nossa base de anunciantes, oferecendo soluções de publicidade integradas (cross-media) que ajudem nossos clientes a alcançar resultados reais.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Prospecção ativa: identificar, qualificar e prospectar (através de cold calls, e-mails, networking e visitas) novas oportunidades de negócios e potenciais anunciantes.
  • Gestão de carteira: gerenciar e rentabilizar a carteira de clientes existente, construindo relacionamentos sólidos e identificando oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell.
  • Consultoria de mídia: entender profundamente as necessidades do cliente e desenvolver propostas comerciais personalizadas, combinando nossas soluções de rádio, portal de notícias e redes sociais.
  • Negociação e fechamento: conduzir todo o ciclo de venda, desde a apresentação da proposta até a negociação e o fechamento do contrato.
  • Pós-venda: acompanhar a entrega e os resultados das campanhas, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Experiência comprovada na área comercial, preferencialmente com vendas de publicidade, mídia (on ou offline), serviços ou em agências.
  • Domínio de técnicas de prospecção ativa e habilidade para abrir novas portas.
  • Sólida experiência em gestão de carteira de cliente , focando em relacionamento e fidelização.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação, negociação e persuasão.
  • Foco em metas, organização e orientação para resultados.


Diferenciais (o que brilha aos nossos olhos):


  • Proatividade: ser alguém que não espera as coisas acontecerem e busca ativamente as soluções.
  • Colaboração em equipe: ter facilidade para trabalhar em conjunto, compartilhar ideias e contribuir para o sucesso do time.
  • Conhecimento do mercado de mídia digital (redes sociais, mídia programática).
  • Possuir veículo próprio (se aplicável para visitas).


Como se candidatar:


Se você é movido(a) a desafios, adora vender e quer crescer junto com um grupo de comunicação de referência, essa vaga é para você!


Envie seu currículo atualizado para:


Por favor, inclua "VAGA CONSULTOR DE VENDAS" no assunto do e-mail.


Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .


Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: LinkedIn Outreach Professional (SDR, BDR, Cold Outreach)
description:
Job description


Location: Remote | Type: Full-Time


About the Opportunity

Do you excel at building meaningful connections through LinkedIn outreach?


At GoGloby, we’re looking for experienced LinkedIn professionals who know how to identify the right people, craft engaging messages, and start conversations that lead to real results. You’ll use your research, communication, and outreach skills to identify, engage, and build meaningful relationships. We’ll provide advanced tools, training, and a results-driven environment where authentic engagement, precision targeting, and measurable outcomes are rewarded. If you’re passionate about strategic LinkedIn networking and driving high-quality responses, you’ll thrive here.


Why You’ll Love Being a LinkedIn Outreach Professional at GoGloby


  • High engagement rates: 50% reply rate to your outreach — because they want to talk to you.
  • Tangible success rewards: You’ll regularly achieve measurable goals and earn meaningful performance bonuses.
  • Collaborative teamwork: You’ll partner with supportive colleagues who share insights, mentor one another, and celebrate wins together.
  • Genuine conversations: Instead of transactional messaging, you’ll build lasting relationships with those who appreciate your approach.
  • Thriving tech & AI industry exposure: You’ll work in one of the fastest-growing global fields — adding serious weight to your experience.
  • International reach: Connect across the U.S., Europe, and LATAM every day.
  • Faster results: See your efforts translate into visible, real-world outcomes in shorter cycles.


Requirements

  • Proven experience in LinkedIn outreach — you know how to connect, engage, and build conversations that get real responses.
  • Hands-on expertise with LinkedIn tools — your go-to toolkit for precision targeting and outreach success.
  • English — you’ll be interacting daily with global professionals across the U.S. and beyond.
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills — you know how to turn a first message into an ongoing professional relationship.
  • Driven by measurable results and bonuses — your efforts directly translate into success metrics and tangible rewards.
  • Collaborative mindset — you’ll work closely with a partner and a supportive global team that shares knowledge, feedback, and success.
  • Strong organization and adaptability — you’re skilled at managing multiple conversations and schedules across time zones while keeping every detail on track.
  • Genuine interest in the tech and AI space — you’ll be engaging with professionals shaping the future of innovation.
  • Performance-oriented approach — you thrive on metrics, continuous improvement, and seeing clear impact from your outreach.
  • Comfort in a fast-paced startup culture — you’re proactive, creative, and excel in a dynamic, globally connected environment.


Activities:

  • Send high-volume headhunting invitations via LinkedIn.
  • Collect and verify candidate contact details (emails, LinkedIn, WhatsApp) with speed and accuracy.
  • Add candidates to the ATS, ensuring complete and up-to-date records.
  • Coordinate and schedule interviews across global time zones
  • Ensure high-quality standards throughout every stage of the hiring pipeline
  • React swiftly to last-minute changes (e.g., cancellations, reschedules)
  • Hit daily/weekly sourcing goals tied to hiring KPIs and performance metrics.


You will get:

  • USD Salary monthly + Commission
  • 100% remote position - Long-term as Contractor
  • Paid vacation + sick leaves
  • Join an international team & grow your career in the tech space
  • Opportunity to work with Silicon Valley (USA) tech companies


About GoGloby

GoGloby is a US-based talent acquisition company that helps Silicon Valley (USA) startups find senior tech talents in LatAm. We work with the most promising founders and Silicon Valley legends like ex-PayPal, ex-Google, and Ethereum execs!

We actively work toward greater diversity, equity, and inclusion We are an equal opportunity company and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Analista de Negócios ServiceNow
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

- Desenvolver o plano e a estratégia da avaliação, alinhando-se às metas do negócio;

- Conduzir entrevistas com stakeholders e realizar levantamento de requisitos;

- Mapear processos atuais e identificar gaps em relação às capacidades nativas do ServiceNow SPM;

- Apoiar o desenvolvimento da matriz de GAP e a análise funcional de conformidade;

- Refinar requisitos e métricas de sucesso para futuras migrações e melhorias;

- Documentar processos e impactos organizacionais;

- Apoiar o planejamento de mudança organizacional (OCM);

- Preparar relatórios, apresentações e entregáveis executivos.


O que você precisa ter:

- Experiência com ServiceNow, tendo participado de pelo menos 5 projetos SPM;

- Especialista funcional em todos os módulos de SPM (Demand, Project, Resource, Portfolio, Financials, etc.);

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita em inglês e português;

- Perfil autogerenciável, proativo e com alta capacidade de entrega em prazos curtos;

- Certificação SPM-CIS fortemente desejável;

- ITIL, PMP ou ServiceNow CSA são diferenciais.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

title: Senior Mobile Flutter Engineer
description:
Senior Mobile Flutter Engineer


Summary

We’re looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer to join one of our partners in building innovative and high-performing mobile applications. You’ll play a key role in designing and developing Flutter-based apps that deliver seamless user experiences, ensuring performance, scalability, and clean architecture across multiple platforms.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement mobile solutions using Flutter , following best practices and scalable patterns.
  • Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and backend engineers to deliver high-quality features.
  • Ensure application performance, responsiveness, and reliability across Android and iOS.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical discussions and architecture decisions.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on Flutter .
  • Deep understanding of mobile architecture, UI frameworks, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, state management (Bloc, Provider, Riverpod), and dependency injection.
  • Solid grasp of Git workflows and agile development practices.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in distributed teams.


Nice to have

  • Experience publishing apps to the App Store and Google Play.
  • Familiarity with native Android (Kotlin) or iOS (Swift) codebases.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for mobile projects.

  • Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and backend engineers to deliver high-quality features.
  • Ensure application performance, responsiveness, and reliability across Android and iOS.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical discussions and architecture decisions.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on Flutter .
  • Deep understanding of mobile architecture, UI frameworks, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, state management (Bloc, Provider, Riverpod), and dependency injection.
  • Solid grasp of Git workflows and agile development practices.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in distributed teams.


Nice to have

  • Experience publishing apps to the App Store and Google Play.
  • Familiarity with native Android (Kotlin) or iOS (Swift) codebases.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for mobile projects.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything:  keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder:  ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree
  • Operate With Efficiency:  put the customer first, write it down, and use AI wherever possible
  • Communication Rules Everything:  be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback
  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful:  don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value; Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter:  have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant:  At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy:  You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
  • Culture:  Have a chat with our teammates, each and everyone has a clear reason about why they love it.

Join Trivium Group - Our award-winning team! Ranked #170 on the Inc. 5000 list and a Clutch Award-winning agency


At Trivium Group, we’re more than just a full-service Amazon agency—we’re a powerhouse of passionate experts helping brands scale profitably on Amazon. We work as an extension of our clients’ teams, providing top-tier strategic growth solutions without the hefty price tag. Our company thrives on strong systems, sharp people, and solid values—and now, we’re looking for an exceptional Accountant (Remote) to join our team!

✅ Competitive Salary $1,500 - $2,500 USD per month

✅ Fully Remote – Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection

✅ Semi-Flexible Hours Core hours: 09:00 - 14:00 (Eastern Standard Time), with flexibility for the remaining 3 hours

Reporting to the Head of Finance

Maintain and reconcile financial transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance

Oversee accounts payable, receivable, and payroll (60+ employees)

Verify and record financial transactions in the correct accounts

Prepare monthly financial reports and adjustments

Monitor and report budget variances

Mandatory: Accounting experience working with SOX / US GAAP or international standard - IFRS

Proficiency in QuickBooks or similar software

Fluency in English (B2 or higher)

Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills

Full-time (40 hours/week)

Immediate Start Date

Quiet workspace with fast internet, webcam, and microphone

Autonomy & Ownership – You'll have the freedom to make an impact!

title: Especialista em Performance Web Front-End
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Performance Web Front-End apaixonado(a) por otimizar a velocidade, a responsividade e a experiência do usuário das nossas aplicações web. O foco principal é garantir o carregamento ultrarrápido das páginas, melhorar as métricas de Core Web Vitals e aplicar as melhores práticas de SEO Técnico, resultando em melhor posicionamento nos mecanismos de busca e aumento nas taxas de conversão.


Principais Responsabilidades

1. Otimização de Performance:

- Analisar, diagnosticar e solucionar gargalos de performance no Front-End (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, imagens, fontes).

- Focar na melhoria contínua das métricas Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) e outras métricas de velocidade (TTFB, FCP, TTI).

- Implementar técnicas de otimização como code splitting, lazy loading, pré-carregamento de recursos (preloading/prefetching), compressão (Gzip/Brotli) e caching avançado.

2. SEO Técnico e Carregamento:

- Garantir a rastreabilidade (crawlability) e indexação eficiente das páginas por bots de mecanismos de busca.

- Otimizar a estrutura do DOM, o uso de HTML semântico e metatags.

- Trabalhar na renderização ideal (server-side, client-side ou híbrida/SSR) para equilibrar performance e SEO.

3. Monitoramento e Análise:

-Utilizar ferramentas como Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Google Search Console e ferramentas de RUM (Real User Monitoring) para monitorar e reportar a performance em ambientes de produção.

-Criar e manter dashboards de performance, identificando tendências e oportunidades de otimização.

4. Colaboração e Educação:

-Colaborar de perto com equipes de Design (UX/UI), Back-End e Marketing/SEO para garantir que as novas funcionalidades sejam lançadas com alta performance e aderência técnica.

-Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e atuar como um mentor técnico, disseminando a cultura de performance para toda a equipe de Front-End.


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais (Hard Skills)


• Proficiência em: HTML semântico, CSS (incluindo pré-processadores ou CSS-in-JS) e JavaScript moderno (ES6+).

• Domínio de Frameworks/Bibliotecas: Experiência avançada em pelo menos um dos principais frameworks de Front-End (React, Vue.js ou Angular), com foco na otimização de builds e carregamento.

• Otimização de Assets: Conhecimento profundo em otimização de imagens (WebP, AVIF, tag), font loading (FOIT, FOUT) e minificação de código.

• Ferramentas de Build/Bundling: Experiência com ferramentas como Webpack, Rollup ou Vite, configurando otimizações para produção.

• Infraestrutura/Rede: Entendimento de redes (HTTP/2, HTTP/3), Content Delivery Networks (CDN) e estratégias de cache no navegador e no servidor.

• SEO Técnico: Conhecimento em Sitemap, Robots.txt, canonicalização, dados estruturados (Schema.org) e experiências de usuário mobile.


Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


• Foco em Resultados: Orientação clara para melhorias mensuráveis (KPIs) de performance e SEO.

• Resolução de Problemas Complexos: Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas que atravessam múltiplas camadas (navegador, rede, servidor, código).

• Comunicação: Habilidade para explicar problemas técnicos complexos e as soluções propostas para audiências não técnicas (marketing, gestão).

• Aprendizado Contínuo: Manter-se atualizado com as constantes mudanças nos algoritmos de busca e nas tecnologias de otimização web.


Diferenciais

• Experiência com SSR (Server-Side Rendering) ou SSG (Static Site Generation) usando frameworks como Next.js ou Nuxt.js.

• Conhecimento de PWA (Progressive Web Apps) e estratégias offline-first.

Experiência em plataformas de Cloud Computing (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) para otimizar o deployment e a entrega.


Habilidades:


Habilidades Técnicas:


- GOOGLE CORE WEB VITALS

- LCP

- CLS

- TTFB

- GOOGLE LIGHTHOUSE

- DASHBOARDS DE PERFORMANCE

- DESIGN DE EXPERIENCIA DO USUARIO (UX/UI)

- HTML semântico

- CSS AVANCADO

- JAVASCRIPT MODERNO (ES6+)

- DESENVOLVEDOR REACT

- DESENVOLVIMENTO COM NEXT.JS

- Nuxt.js

- PWA (PROGRESSIVE WEB APPS)

- ADMINISTRACAO DA CLOUD AWS

- PROCESSAMENTO DE SITEMAPS

- DATADOG RUM (REAL USER MONITORING)


Habilidades Comportamentais:


- Foco em resultados

- Resolução de problemas complexos

- COMUNICATIVO

- Adaptação e Aprendizado Contínuo


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!


Assistência médica;

VR e VA flexível;

Gympass e Wellz;

Parceria com o SESC;

Descontos em restaurantes;

Descontos em cursos técnicos e de ensinos superior;

Descontos em escolas e plataformas de idiomas.


E aí, aceita o desafio? Então conclua sua candidatura e #VemSerFoursys! Boa sorte!

- Trabalhar na renderização ideal (server-side, client-side ou híbrida/SSR) para equilibrar performance e SEO.

title: Tech Recruiter (Remoto)
description:
Um cliente Brunel do setor de tecnologia está em busca de um(a) Tech Recruiter para atuar em um momento de crescimento acelerado e construção de processos do zero . A área de recrutamento ainda está se estruturando, por isso buscamos alguém que não apenas conduza processos seletivos de ponta a ponta, mas que também curta o desafio de criar, evoluir e implementar boas práticas na área.

Se você tem experiência com posições de tecnologia , gosta de ambientes dinâmicos, menos estruturados e repletos de oportunidades de aprendizado , essa vaga é pra você!


Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto

Tipo de contrato: PJ


Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir processos seletivos de ponta a ponta (kick-off, hunting, triagem, entrevistas, feedbacks e fechamento);
  • Realizar hunting ativo, especialmente para posições de tecnologia;
  • Gerenciar candidatos e vagas via Gupy (ATS) ;
  • Conduzir e dar andamento ao programa de indicações internas;
  • Fazer alinhamentos frequentes com lideranças contratantes, garantindo clareza e alinhamento de expectativas;
  • Construir e manter pipelines de talentos para posições futuras;
  • Conduzir entrevistas por competências, avaliando tanto aspectos técnicos quanto comportamentais;
  • Priorizar diversidade, equidade e inclusão nos processos seletivos;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de Employer Branding em momentos de menor volume de vagas;
  • Atuar em um ambiente de startup em crescimento , colaborando para a evolução de processos, políticas e boas práticas de recrutamento;
  • Acompanhar e analisar métricas de recrutamento (SLA, tempo de fechamento, conversão de etapas), gerando insights de melhoria;
  • Organizar e priorizar demandas em cenários de alto volume de processos.


Perfil desejado:

  • Experiência prévia em recrutamento e seleção;
  • Vivência com recrutamento de posições de tecnologia ;
  • Familiaridade com ATS ;
  • Experiência em entrevistas por competências ;
  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade de construir relações de confiança com gestores e candidatos;
  • Organização, capacidade analítica e agilidade para lidar com múltiplas vagas;
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade para atuar em um ambiente de startup;
  • Vontade constante de aprender e se desenvolver.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com programas de diversidade, equidade e inclusão ;
  • Vivência em projetos de Employer Branding ;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de recrutamento (SLA, tempo de fechamento, conversão de etapas);
  • Espanhol avançado .

title: Business Development & Partnerships Specialist
description:
UserGuiding is a SaaS product that helps web applications show their value propositions by enabling them to improve their ease of use. Interactive product tours, which can be created without coding, help product managers, marketers, and UX designers to make changes to the interfaces of their platforms. Personalized guides, built-in minutes, decrease the customer support workload by accelerating the onboarding process.


Role Objective


The main goal of this role is to increase our pipeline and generate demand in Brazil by building strong relationships with associations, influencers, and communities.


The person in this position will work closely with the marketing team , reporting weekly on partnerships, events, and lead generation metrics. 


Main Responsibilities


1. Partnerships & Outreach


  • Identify and build relationships with associations, communities (e.g., ABStartups), and influencers.
  • Organize partnership calls and follow up with stakeholders.
  • Create and maintain a list of relevant industry events.
  • Conduct market research to identify trends, opportunities, and potential partners in the ecosystem.
  • Attend or represent the company at local events, meetups, and workshops.
  • Host or co-host online / offline events and product demos.


2. Community & Customer Relations


  • Lead and grow our community presence in Brazil.
  • Build strong relationships with customers and webinar attendees.
  • Engage with users and prospects on LinkedIn; send connection requests, interact with posts, and identify advocates.
  • Understand customer needs and collect insights to improve local strategy and messaging for different purposes, such as ad copies.
  • Help with local content creation (reports, articles, or interviews in PT-BR).


3. Brand Awareness


  • Explore PR opportunities to feature the company in relevant Brazilian magazines, online blogs, podcasts, social media influencers, and panels.
  • Coordinate or organize small gatherings, dinners, or networking events for target audiences.
  • Represent the company in local communities and industry discussions.



Skills & Tools


Business Development Tools


  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator (prospecting & outreach)
  • HubSpot CRM (lead tracking, pipeline management, email sequences)
  • Apollo.io and similars (contact enrichment)
  • Google Sheets (for organizing lists of events, influencers, and associations)
  • Zoom / Meet / Loom (for calls and demos)


Marketing & Community Tools


  • Contrast (organizing events)
  • Canva 
  • Slack / WhatsApp / Discord (for community or internal comms)


Skillset Needed


  • Strong networking and relationship-building ability
  • Excellent written and spoken Portuguese (and English for coordination)
  • Public speaking or hosting confidence (for webinars/podcasts)
  • Strategic thinking and curiosity about the software ecosystem in Brazil
  • Strong project management.
  • Native Spanish speaking is more than welcome. :)

title: Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Java Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics and performance management.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Brazil | SRE, Java & .NET Engineers (Remote)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Our mission is to be a meaningful part of our people's careers. As we grow, so does our determination to offer the best experience to our employees and clients — and that’s exactly what drives us. We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with offices in Lisbon, Porto and Óbidos, and representations in Brazil and Tunisia. We have over 12 years of market expertise, and today we are a universe of around 400 people working on-site, remotely or in hybrid mode in projects across 20+ countries.


We believe that great people make successful companies, and that’s why we stand for the appreciation, recognition and growth of our professionals.


We don’t want to be just another line on your CV — we want you to live a Lifetime Experience with us. We invest in training and certifications that confirm your real progression, in promoting a healthy work-life balance, and in offering benefits that impact your personal life and career.


#welcometoyourfuture

Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)

– 4 to 6 years of experience in Java development

– Experience with integration, APIs, testing, and troubleshooting
